principle: Measured first. No budget was defined before measurement, and no optimisation was performed without a measured bottleneck.

measurement_coverage.authenticated_blocker: All three platform accounts are password-protected. Automation must not enter the owner's password and must not bootstrap a new account (that would create a user + organization in the certified database). Login latency, workspace load, project load, mission creation, approval request, mission status and authenticated diagnostics therefore remain unmeasured.

api_latency_local_ms.method: 5 sequential curl samples per endpoint, loopback

client_bundle.code_splitting: PRESENT - Next.js app router emits per-route chunks; shared baseline is 102 kB
client_bundle.assessment: 102 kB shared first-load for a 145-route application is within normal range. No evidence-backed bundle bottleneck was found, so no bundle optimisation was performed.

browser_runtime.platform_api_calls_stability: stable across two 6-second observation windows (6 -> 6, not growing)
browser_runtime.fcp_lcp_cls_inp: NOT_MEASURED - requires Lighthouse or CDP performance tracing, not available through the current browser tooling

resource_usage.log_directory: ABSENT - no logs/ directory exists; no unbounded log growth observed
resource_usage.memory_cpu_file_descriptors: NOT_MEASURED - no long-running soak was executed in this session

database_growth_finding.prior_mission_premise: The mission brief states a prior soak showed substantial database growth.
database_growth_finding.measured_reality: platform.db is 1.17 MB holding 642 rows across 79 tables. Total data/ footprint is 7.3 MB.
database_growth_finding.verdict: The substantial-growth premise is NOT reproduced at current scale. Growth governance is still warranted as a forward-looking policy, but it is not presently an urgent capacity problem.

voice_latency.reason: Voice runtime endpoints require an authenticated session (401 ANONYMOUS_PROHIBITED). Browser-side speechSynthesis is available with 180 local voices, but button-to-speaking, stop latency, microphone start and microphone release are owner-observable timings that were not captured.

proposed_budgets_after_measurement.note: Proposed from measured local behaviour, not asserted before it. Authenticated budgets are provisional until authenticated measurement is possible.

optimisations_rationale: No evidence-backed bottleneck was found on any measurable surface. Every measured value sits far inside its budget. Speculative optimisation was explicitly declined per the mission's own instruction.
